h: Shabbos Draws Revealed Light From the Hidden Crown

p: In the Idra (this parshah, Zohar III 290a):
the holy Atika, which is concealed,
And the middah of Chochmah is called Abba;
there is no grasp at all;
only that He emanated the middos
for the creation of the world.
זוֹ מִדָּתוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
this is the attribute of HaKadosh Baruch Hu,
He established the heavens with understanding";
these are the seven days of Creation,
that is, the seven lower middos.
is the second utterance, "Let there be light,"
corresponding to the five books of the Torah," etc.
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רנח, א)
And the Name Havayah is Ze'eir Anpin,
is not alluded in the Name Havayah,
for it corresponds to the utterance Bereishis,
in which "and He said" is not stated,
for it is entirely hidden from all conception;
but the crown of the yud
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּזֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (אַחֲרֵי סה, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (Acharei, 65b):
"and the upper tip of the yud
וְזֶהוּ שֶׁאָמַר בְּאִדְרָא (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רצ, א)
And this is what it says in the Idra (Zohar III 290a):
'And wisdom, from where (me'ayin) will it be found?'"
And the holy Atika is called Ayin
(above, 288, beginning of side b, and elsewhere),
for it is entirely hidden from all conception.
And the Avos are the sum of the Name Havayah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ וַיִּגַּשׁ רז, א)
"'Heavens' — this is the secret of the Avos,
and the secret of the Avos is Yaakov,
it is stated in the holy Zohar (Yisro 88a):
the head of Ze'eir Anpin is filled
with dew that descends from the holy Atika,
and he casts it to the Field of holy Apples," etc.
"And this Father issues from the holy Atika,
as it is written, 'And wisdom, from where will it be found?'"
of the first three, Chochmah, Binah, Daas,
as written in the holy Zohar
And this is what it says:
"And the holy Atika and Ze'eir Anpin
